scenes.headline: Real-time Ingestion
scenes.subtitle: Stream events into the lakehouse continuously
scenes.narration: Real-time ingestion continuously loads streaming events into Delta tables for near-instant analytics.

scenes.headline: Core building blocks
items: Sources like Kafka, Event Hubs, or cloud files
scenes.narration: Structured Streaming treats an unbounded stream as an ever-growing table. It connects to sources such as Kafka, Event Hubs, or arriving files. Checkpoints track progress so failures recover without duplicating or losing data.

scenes.headline: Streaming Kafka into Delta
scenes.code:
from pyspark.sql.functions import from_json, col

raw = (spark.readStream
    .format("kafka")
    .option("kafka.bootstrap.servers", "broker:9092")
    .option("subscribe", "clickstream")
    .load())

parsed = raw.select(from_json(col("value").cast("string"), schema).alias("e")).select("e.*")

(parsed.writeStream
    .format("delta")
    .option("checkpointLocation", "/chk/clickstream")
    .trigger(processingTime="30 seconds")
    .table("bronze.clickstream_events"))
scenes.narration: We read a continuous stream from a Kafka topic and parse the JSON payload against a schema. A processing-time trigger writes micro-batches into a Delta table every thirty seconds. The checkpoint location guarantees exactly-once delivery across restarts.

scenes.headline: Streaming pipeline
scenes.narration: Events flow from the source into a Structured Streaming job. The job writes small, frequent micro-batches into Delta. Downstream dashboards query fresh data within seconds of arrival.

scenes.headline: Design considerations
items: Tune trigger interval for latency versus cost
Enable auto-compaction to avoid small files
Monitor input rate, batch duration, and lag
scenes.narration: Shorter triggers cut latency but raise cost and file counts. Auto-compaction keeps streaming tables from fragmenting into tiny files. Watching throughput and lag helps you catch backpressure early.

scenes.text: Structured Streaming plus Delta plus checkpoints equals reliable real-time ingestion.
scenes.narration: The lakehouse turns a firehose of events into query-ready tables within seconds.
